overview.description: The Vanguard U.S. Momentum Factor ETF (VFMO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in large-, mid-, and small-cap US stocks with high momentum. VFMO was launched on Feb 13, 2018 and is issued by Vanguard.
